mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that intensifies supply chain disruptions, reducing corporate margins and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increase exceeding 0.5% signals inflation acceleration that triggers central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 2 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases above 4.5% and retail sales (RSAFS) declines indicate labor demand destruction and reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signal active monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.
